6968.title: ACP prompt usage is not forwarded
6968.rootCauseOneLine: ACP prompt completion reads Grok context metadata but never translates top-level usage into a token-usage delta.
6968.proposedFix: Validate prompt usage and emit existing usage deltas after resolving per-turn versus cumulative counters and dialect cache semantics.
6968.caveats: Real bridge reproduction repeated in two clean trusted-main checkouts. Test and fixture code are inline in the HTML per reports repository rules. Live Copilot and Burn costs were not exercised. No automatic PR: accounting semantics require a product decision. Normal full builds encountered an unrelated SDK runtime build-order failure; the focused regression failed as expected and three existing controls passed.
